description: Files and links attached to a user's tasks and projects. Import THIRTY-FIRST (after user_tasks)
notes: ONE table serves both tasks and projects, keyed by parent_type + parent_id. A second near-identical table would double every query and every service for no gain.

parent_id is TEXT holding a user_tasks or user_projects ROW id. Deliberately not a link_row: a link field can only point at one table, and filtering one needs link_row_has with a row id the client does not always have. Same reasoning as project_id in 28-user-tasks.json.
Users live in Xano, so user_id is TEXT holding String(user.id) - never a link field. EVERY read filters on it.

url holds a Baserow media URL (from POST /api/database/../user-files/upload-file/) or, for kind='link', an external address. THE MEDIA URL IS PUBLIC: unguessable, but readable by anyone who has it, with no authentication. Verified 2026-08-15. The app discloses this before the first upload; see AttachmentUploadService.

baserow_name is the opaque file name the upload returned. It is the ONLY handle by which the stored file could ever be deleted, and a database token cannot delete it - deleting a row here detaches the file, it does not erase it. Keep the column so a future server-side proxy can do the real thing.
size_bytes exists so a per-user quota is one SUM over this column rather than a walk over storage.
width and height come back from the upload response and are stored so a gallery can reserve space before the image loads.
kind is decided ONCE, at upload, from the MIME type - so every view agrees about what a file is without re-sniffing it.

title.description: Original filename, or the link title. Primary field

user_id.description: Xano user id as a string. EVERY read filters on this

url.description: Baserow media URL, or an external link. PUBLIC - see notes

thumbnail_url.description: Baserow's own small thumbnail. Images only

size_bytes.description: Quota is a SUM of this column

baserow_name.description: The stored file's opaque name. The only handle for a real delete
